name: blender_import
description: Search and import assets into the attached Blender: BlenderKit (models, materials, HDRIs; needs the BlenderKit add-on), Sketchfab (downloadable models; needs the Sketchfab add-on, activated when its session was lost) or a file (glTF, FBX, OBJ, USD: a path or an https URL). search lists results without asking; import asks the blender_import permission and returns a task (downloads run in the background): call again with task and wait_s to follow it, or cancel. The task's result names what it created.

asset_type.description: BlenderKit: model, material, hdr, scene, brush or nodegroup (default model).

id.description: import: a BlenderKit asset_base_id or a Sketchfab uid, from a search.

path.description: import from file: a file path (absolute or relative to the project) or an https:// URL.

target_object.description: BlenderKit material: the object that receives it.

location.description: BlenderKit model: [x, y, z] where it lands.

task.description: A task from an earlier import: its progress and result.

wait_s.description: With import or task: wait up to this long for the task to finish (0 to 3600).
